verdict.rationale: Airbyte OSS ships official self-hosting paths (OSS quickstart, abctl for Docker, Kubernetes deployment guide) and community confirms real-world self-hosted usage ('we use airbyte at my company, although we self-host it'). Some friction is documented (an older HN complaint about docker-compose failing, and a claim that some features are gated behind paid tiers), so it's not flawless. Missing for 10: independent verification that recent installers are reliable, and clearer confirmation that all 'core' functionality (not just OSS-tier) is self-hostable without paid add-ons.
